title: Figure 17: Fundamental Problem of Transformation-Based Cloaking Devices – grid diagrams
description: Two grid diagrams labeled A and B. Panel A shows a uniform grid with a blue circle, a red center point and a straight yellow light ray. Panel B shows the grid compressed into a shell around a red inner circle, with the yellow ray detouring around it. The caption reads "Figure 17. Fundamental Problem of Transformation-Based Cloaking Devices"; the text explains that light inside the cloak would need to travel infinitely fast.
